criteria.name: Requirement Completeness
criteria.description: Does the artifact fully address all constraints specified in the user goal?

criteria.name: Clarity & Structural Precision
criteria.description: Is the content well-organized with clean typography, clear headings, high-contrast tables, and zero visual overlap?

criteria.name: Verifiability & Fact Grounding
criteria.description: Are claims supported by data, logic, or explicit source references?

criteria.name: Scope & Formatting Appropriateness
criteria.description: Is the deliverable format appropriate? Are internal artifacts kept in raw Markdown without unnecessary HTML file compilation or visual bloat?
